name: New App
prompt:
Let's build a fully 3d battle chess game. The Player plays against the computer (or if 2 players want to play and swap the keyboard). 

The starting menu should show a few different boards with different themes - Classic, Animals, Vehicles, Ninjas, etc that can be selected before the game. 

The game has a running timer, so users know how long they have been playing. This can be paused at any time. 

Movement should be turn based. You should be able to highlight all available moves, and when you choose a space, it should play a "Defeat" or "Destroy" animation and take the enemy players space. 

Whomever wins should have their King standing on the enemy King with the words `Victorious!` displayed with options to start a new game.
